# THE TEST (Lon 2026-09-26 15:0x CDT, verbatim: "So the way to tell if a program is SPITBOL dialect is two-fold, 1st is rejected by SPITBOL, and 2nd why it is rejected is a CSNOBOL4 feature not supported. Then if these two are true it is NOT SPITBOL dialect."; ceo CEO-1286).

# ⭐ AND THE PROGRAMS LON DEFERRED PAST THE ANNOUNCEMENT (ceo CEO-1345; Lon 2026-09-27 19:3x CDT, in-chat to the ceo, verbatim: "The EXIT() feaure to save/resume executables will be done but after the announcement"): class DEFERRED-AFTER-ANNOUNCEMENT-LON-2026-09-27, name<TAB>class<TAB>evidence citing CEO-1345. These the oracle RUNS: EXIT(3,file)/EXIT(-3) writes a resumable SPITBOL load module, which SCRIP cannot yet do (row snobol4-exit-3-file-writes-a-resumable-load-module-...-ceo-1344, PARKED-LON-HOLD). The runner still grades them and names their verdicts; they leave pass, fail, rc and the denominator, and each row is deleted the day that row lands. Measured 2026-09-28 on SCRIP 9023495fa: sbl -bf as below, SCRIP m3 raises error 22 (EXIT undefined) at the EXIT statement.
